product.description: Replacement power adapter (Model ADLX65CCGU2A, ADLX65CLGU2A) for Lenovo IdeaPad 100, 110, 310, 320, 330, 330S, 510, 520, 530S, 710S, S145, S340, Slim 3, Slim 5, Yoga 510, Yoga 710, Yoga 720, and Flex 4, Flex 5, Flex 6 Series. 20V, 3.25A, 65W output through the small round 4.0mm x 1.7mm barrel connector (also compatible with matching 45W, 20V/2.25A configurations). Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Not compatible with ThinkPad models using the larger rectangular Slim Tip or USB Pin connectors. Tested before dispatch, drop-in replacement for the original charger.

faqs.question: How do I know this charger fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows the wattage and connector type. If you're unsure, send us a photo of your original charger or your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Is a higher-wattage charger safe to use?
faqs.answer: Yes — a charger rated higher than your laptop's original wattage is safe; your laptop only draws what it needs. A lower-wattage charger should be avoided.
